# mesh_for_atoms { #mofography.visualize.mesh_for_atoms }

```python
visualize.mesh_for_atoms(
    ase_atoms,
    bonds=None,
    colormap=None,
    bond_rgba_array=[127, 128, 129, 255],
    kwargs_spheres=dict(scale=0.8, radii=None),
    kwargs_cylinders=dict(radius=0.25),
    return_scene=False,
    use_batched=True,
    representation='ball_and_stick',
)
```

Build a ball-and-stick trimesh (or Scene) from an ASE atoms object and optional bonds.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type   | Description                                                                                                                       | Default                       |
|------------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------|
| ase_atoms        |        | an ASE atoms object                                                                                                               | _required_                    |
| bonds            |        | a list of bonds, where each bond is a list of two atom indices                                                                    | `None`                        |
| colormap         |        | a dictionary of colors for each atomic number                                                                                     | `None`                        |
| bond_rgba_array  |        | The color of the bonds                                                                                                            | `[127, 128, 129, 255]`        |
| kwargs_spheres   |        | dict of arguments for the spheres, see the spheres_for_atom function                                                              | `dict(scale=0.8, radii=None)` |
| kwargs_cylinders |        | radius of the cylinder, see the cylinders_for_bonds function                                                                      | `dict(radius=0.25)`           |
| return_scene     |        | if True, returns a trimesh.Scene object, which can be rendered with the trimesh.Scene.show() method, defaults to False (optional) | `False`                       |
| use_batched      |        | if True, uses the fast numpy-batched path (~300× faster), defaults to True                                                        | `True`                        |
| representation   |        | "ball_and_stick", "stick", or "space_filling"                                                                                     | `'ball_and_stick'`            |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description             |
|--------|--------|-------------------------|
|        |        | A trimesh.Scene object. |
